about.title: Free, independent and sourced
about.p1: Home Ready is a free programme from Potential.org, the nonprofit arm of Potential.com. It helps people in the UAE make better decisions about renting or buying a home: what to check, what it really costs, what to ask, and when renting or buying makes more sense for you.
about.quote: We never recommend specific properties; we teach you how to judge them.
about.p2: Every fee and rule we show has an official source and the date we checked it. Home Ready is education, not legal, financial or mortgage advice.

why.title: Better housing decisions, one step at a time.
why.body: Housing is the biggest monthly cost for most UAE residents. A clear checklist and a true-cost view before you sign can save thousands of dirhams and a lot of stress.

dalil.name: Dalil
dalil.q: Can my landlord raise the rent at renewal in Dubai?
dalil.a: In Dubai, rent increases at renewal are linked to the RERA Rental Index for your area and need 90 days' written notice before the contract ends. You can check your area on the DLD Rental Index calculator.
dalil.source: Checked on 25 Nov 2026 · Source: Dubai Land Department.
dalil.note: This is education, not legal advice.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: The plain-language rules for using Home Ready, a free programme from Potential.org.

about.title: What Home Ready is
about.body: Home Ready is a free education programme from Potential.org, the nonprofit arm of Potential.com. It helps people in the UAE make better decisions about renting or buying a home through short videos, readings, decision journeys, a calculator and checklists.

advice.title: Education, not advice
advice.body: Home Ready is education, not legal, financial or mortgage advice. Fees and rules come from official sources with the date we checked them, but they can change. For your own case, speak to a qualified adviser before you sign or pay.

accounts.title: Your account
accounts.body: You must be 18 or older to join. Keep your password private and tell us at hello@potential.org if you think someone else has used your account. You can close your account at any time from your profile.

use.title: Fair use
use.body: Use Home Ready for your own learning. Do not copy content for resale, try to break the service, upload harmful material or share other people's personal details in Ask Dalil or any form.

sponsors.title: Sponsors and offers
sponsors.body: Sponsors help keep Home Ready free. Every sponsored slot and offer carries a "Sponsored" label. Sponsors never change our content, and we only pass your details to a partner when you say yes to that specific request.

content.title: Our content
content.body: Videos, readings, journeys and checklists belong to Potential.org. You may save and print them for personal use. Results from the calculator and journeys are estimates based on the numbers you enter.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms as the programme grows. We will show the new date at the top of this page and tell registered learners by email about any important change.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates as applied in the Emirate of Dubai.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: What we collect, why we collect it and the choices you control.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: When you join: your name, email, password (stored encrypted), emirate, what brings you here, preferred language and, if you choose, a UAE mobile number and how you heard about us. While you learn: your progress, quiz scores, saved checklists, calculator results, reminders and questions to Dalil.

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To run your account, save your progress, send the reminders you set and improve the programme. Programme reports use totals only, never individual learners.

marketing.title: Marketing emails
marketing.body: Home Ready tips and new-content emails are off unless you tick the box at sign-up or turn them on in your profile. You can turn them off again with one click from any email.

partners.title: Partners and sponsors
partners.body: We never share your details with a sponsor or partner unless you give a separate yes for that one request. Each request shows who will contact you and what they will receive. Sponsors only see aggregate figures.

never.title: What we never ask for
never.body: We do not collect Emirates ID numbers, passport numbers, bank account or card details. Dalil is designed to decline them if you type them.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your account data while your account is open and delete it within 30 days after you close it, except records we must keep by law.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can see, download, correct or delete your data from your profile, or ask us at hello@potential.org. We reply within 30 days.

editorial.title: Editorial policy
editorial.intro: How we keep Home Ready accurate, dated and independent of the sponsors who fund it.

independence.title: Independent of sponsors
independence.body: Sponsors help keep Home Ready free. They never write, edit or approve our lessons, journeys, calculator or Dalil answers, and they cannot pay to change a result or a ranking.

sources.title: Every fee and rule is sourced and dated
sources.body: Each fee, percentage or rule names its official source, such as the Dubai Land Department, RERA or DEWA, and the date we last checked it. Market practice is labelled as market practice, not as a rule. Content always says which emirate it applies to.

review.title: Reviewed before it goes live
review.body: A qualified reviewer checks every lesson, journey step and Dalil answer against its source before it is published, in English and Arabic. Content is re-checked at least every six months or when a rule changes.

labels.title: Clear labels
labels.body: Sponsored content and offers always carry a "Sponsored" label in the top corner of the slot. Sample and fictional content is labelled as such.

recommendations.title: No recommendations
recommendations.body: We do not recommend specific properties, buildings, agents, banks or developers, sponsors included. We teach you how to judge any option yourself.

corrections.title: Corrections
corrections.body: Found something wrong or out of date? Write to hello@potential.org. We check every report, correct the content and update its check date.
